phase: V2-1 Workstream B tennis ATP Match Winner
dataset: data/interim/v2_tennis_market_dataset.csv (built by scripts/build_v2_tennis_market_dataset.py; 12,202 rows; combined source hash prefix 6f1237b6c705777a)
population: ATP TML non-walkover, Betfair MATCH_ODDS MATCHED link, both runners LTP at or before start-30min, each <=1h old
stack_definition: logistic regression on [logit(market_multiplicative), logit(elo_global)] fitted on development years only
selection_rule: default unless a candidate has holdout log loss lower with paired-bootstrap 95% CI (seed 20260923, 2000 resamples) excluding zero; if several, the largest improvement
reported: log loss, Brier, AUC, calibration intercept/slope, top-pick accuracy, expected vs actual correct, bands 50-54.9..95%+, thresholds >=55..>=95 with Wilson CIs, subgroups by year/surface/tourney_level/best_of
decision_gate: A calibrated on holdout (slope 95% CI includes 1 AND every band with n>=200 has its realised rate inside its Wilson CI of the predicted mean +-) AND live source demonstrated; B calibrated but no dependable live source; C calibration fails; D new information required
